caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a decorative glass vase or lamp base. The object consists of a large, bulbous, clear, and transparent upper portion that tapers smoothly into a narrower neck, which connects to a banded, ribbed segment at the midpoint. Below the ribbed section, the base of the object is square and appears to be made of a solid, textured material, detailed with geometric and leaf-like ornamental patterns on all visible sides. The drawing is presented in grayscale, using shades of gray and black for shading, transparency, and texture, on a beige or off-white background. The artist's name, "John Tarantino," is written in small letters at the lower left corner of the image.
title: Lamp
